business_model.answer: Freemium subscription. A free plan (ad-supported, 1 village, 2 members) and two paid plans, Circle and Village, sold inside the app; businesses can contact them to use it for patients or clients, and gift subscriptions exist. Run by Caring Village Inc. (App Store seller: Caring Village Holdings, LLC); no funding figure was found.

who_uses_who_pays.answer: Family caregivers and their helpers use it. The person who creates the village pays if they need more members or villages; everyone they invite joins free. Someone can also buy a gift subscription for a caregiver, and businesses can arrange use for their clients.

evidence.quote: It’s always free to join a village as a member
Caring Village is for both family and professional caregivers.
Buying for a caregiver? Explore gift subscriptions

cost.answer: Free: $0 (1 village, 2 members). Circle: $14.99/month (2 villages, 5 members each). Village: $24.99/month (5 villages, 50 members each on the pricing page, 25 in the FAQ). Annual billing saves 17% ($12.49 and $20.83 a month billed yearly). The app download is free.

how_they_differentiate.answer: They claim to be one shared command center for all of a family's caregiving (calendar, medications, journal, messages, documents) instead of scattered texts and spreadsheets, built by people who were caregivers themselves, with a 24/7 AI assistant called Julia.

evidence.quote: Caring Village replaces the scattered texts, spreadsheets, and sticky notes with a single command center.
Caring Village is a first-of-its kind online dashboard and mobile app
We've walked in your shoes. Every feature we build starts with real caregiver struggles we've lived through ourselves.
Julia answers caregiving questions 24/7

unique_value_proposition.answer: One free app where the whole family coordinates a loved one's care together, so no one carries it alone.

evidence.quote: Join families using Caring Village to simplify caregiving with a single, free app that keeps everyone connected and informed.
Coordinating care together, so no one does it alone.

retain_customers.answer: The free plan caps a village at 2 members, so larger families must upgrade; paid plans remove ads and add document folders, care plans and calendar sync. Plans can be cancelled any time in the app. Day-to-day pull comes from shared to-dos, reminders and a wellness journal family members can like and comment on.

evidence.quote: Our free villages can have up to two members.
Yes! You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription at any time from the My Subscription section in the app.
Share photos and updates with your care circle, where family members can like, comment, and stay emotionally connected

customer_experience.answer: Self-serve: a help center, a support email, a guided village setup, a 30-second plan quiz, expert checklists, and the AI assistant Julia for caregiving questions at any hour. No human phone support or hours are mentioned.

relatives_joining.answer: Yes. The village creator invites family, friends, neighbors and care professionals; each joins with their own free account and gets role-based permissions. How many can join depends on the creator's plan (2 free, up to 5 or 50 paid).

evidence.quote: Users can build an online village for their loved ones and invite family members, friends, neighbors, and professional caregivers to participate in their care.

privacy_data_consent.answer: They collect medications, appointments, journal entries and uploaded medical and legal documents. Data is encrypted, seen only by village members according to roles the creator controls, never sold, and shared with hosting, payment and analytics providers. Account and data deletion is by emailing support; how a single member is removed is not stated.
